name: bookflow
description: Mini SaaS booking & dashboard analitik untuk bisnis jasa (salon, barbershop). Next.js 16 · Prisma 7 · Neon · Auth.js — live demo tersedia

paragraphs: Mini SaaS Booking & Analytics Dashboard for service businesses (barbershops, salons, and similar services). Record customer bookings, manage service offerings, and track performance with analytics.
🔗 Live demo: bookflow-ruddy.vercel.app 👤 Demo Account: Click “Try Demo” / “Login as Demo” (no signup required)
features: Authentication — Register and log in via Auth.js v5 (bcrypt password hashing, JWT sessions) with protected dashboard routes.
Service Management — Full CRUD operations for services (name, duration, price, active/inactive toggle).
Booking Management — Full CRUD for bookings, status filters, and inline status updates (pending → confirmed → completed / cancelled).
Analytics Dashboard — Metric summary cards (revenue, total bookings, today's bookings, average ticket size), revenue and booking trend charts (7 and 30 days), and top-performing services.
Demo Account — One-click instant access pre-populated with realistic sample data.
